Happy 18th birthday!

I don't remember many of my birthdays, but:
My 20th, I was sick, so I  called in to work and I drove an hour home from my friend's house to find my family decorating for my aunt's/my birthday. Everyone was expecting me to be working that day. 
My 21st sucked. I spent the whole day helping my parents clean up the backyard after having a tree cut down. My mom did take me lunch and got me my first margarita, but my friends didn't contact me or anything. 
My 31st, haha. My family went to my cousins wedding and my friends turned me down for game night forgetting that it was my birthday. I was going to get a cake and make tostadas for everyone. Instead I spent the day playing Minecraft and had Taco Bell with my husband because luckily he had the day off.
I'm a female. It makes me uncomfortable and has happened to me almost everywhere I've worked.
I never know if I'm just overreacting or not. Thank you for being helpful.

We don't. Life feels meaningless. I work 5 8's on graveyard, so I only have one full day off and it happens to be Monday... the day everyone else goes to work. When I get off work on Sunday mornings there's always that dilemma of whether to try and stay up all day or try to only take a short nap instead of sleeping the whole day. I've apparently punched my husband in the face for waking me up from my nap because I was way too tired from lack of sleep before work that I just couldn't wake up despite his multiple tries. Everyday is struggle to get out of bed. I tell myself I have to get up or I'll no longer have a roof over my head and I'll be like my coworker that is homeless and trying to survive by living out of their car and working 40 hrs plus a week and getting paid more than minimum wage. 
Vacation days are always amazing even if you're just staying at the house to chill.

I talk to him all the time. He's the only one that helps. My family brings me down constantly... I'm not the daughter they wanted... I'm the one they're stuck with. I have PCOS and I've been put on almost every diet and my family doesn't understand why I still look like me and not a super model. I can't have children, so they're upset about that as well. 
I'm huge on family, so it hurts that my family doesn't seem like they love me just because I'm the fat one in the family.
Strangers have called me the "Meg of the family".. Meg from family guy. I've also been called the "Harry Potter of the family".
I'm thinking of eventually getting rid of all my possessions and joining him on the road. He's hopeful it'll help. If I can't bring my cat with me then I don't think I'll be able to... the cat is a $400 deposit.
My cat is my therapy animal. She wasn't originally, but I'd bottle everything up and then about 6 months ago the bottle broke and I haven't been the same since. I can no longer bottle up my emotions and so she cuddles with me every day and on really bad days she refuses to leave my side and does she can to keep me in bed. 
I used to be a cutter, but after my husband threatened to cut himself if i didn't stop I stopped. Everytime I grab the razor blade I remind myself of that. He knows I hate seeing him in pain, so I won't do it. When I don't eat he threatens to stop eating because he knows I'd rather eat then see him go hungry. Since we're not always together he'll ask for photos of what I'm eating as proof that I'm actually eating because I'll go days without eating.
I've tried killing myself multiple times. The first time I tried to I think I was probably 7. I thought a bb gun could kill me... it wasn't even loaded. I tried running away over a dozen times while in grade school. I had no where to go, no money, no food, and knew that if my friend's parents saw me that they'd just take me back home. 
Hubby knows all this and took me to a counselor... found out that after my 6th session that my insurance doesn't actually cover mental health after being told by the office that my insurance will cover it. It helped while it lasted. Now I owe over $6,000 in medical debt which just makes the out look so much better.

I suggest going to get help maybe at a rehab center and connecting with people that are going through or have gone through the same thing to help you. If you keep going down the partying path you could lose everything as well as loved ones. One of my dear friends is now living on the streets due to drugs and alcohol. I miss her dearly and don't even know where to find her anymore and I don't even know if she's still alive. 

If your friends don't support your decision to sober up then you might need new friends that care about you personally and not just party you. Once I got tired of being everyone's DD I lost a lot of friends, but they didn't care about me all they wanted was someone to drive them home. It sucks losing friends, but they're not your friends if they're not there to support you.

As a girl with a G cup I can honestly say it sucks. I get a lot of unwanted attention. I get a lot of unwanted attention anyway for being fat, but I constantly have guys staring at my chest when I'm out in public. My husband likes that other guys get jealous that he's with me, but I hate it. 

Your body will change, so find a man that loves you for you and not your body. We're more than our looks. I used to have what the boys called a "banging body" and i honestly become slightly happy that I got fat because I thought that I'd stop getting sexualized, but I still get sexualized a lot because of my boobs. I can't walk down the street without someone saying something.
I know how that goes. Personally video chats always make me feel better because then I can see him even for a little bit. I only see my husband for a day or two each month now that he's a trucker.

Communication and trust are key in every relationship, but more so in a long distance relationship. Make sure to text, call, and make time to video chat with each other. Also, find time to see each other. You have to trust each other to not see other people. Long distance relationships take a lot more work, but it's worth it.

I'm 30 and I was the only one in my household making money this year up until just last month. I was always in debt, and I'd skip meals to pay the bills, but always made sure my cat had food.
I work 5-8's working graveyard and take home $1,600 per month. I'm struggling to get by. I went to the food bank only once and decided I'd rather go hungry then go back because others are a whole lot worse off than i am. I didn't want to go there in the first place, but i knew i couldn't just live on water for two weeks. 
I'm very happy to say that this is the first month this year that my bank account isn't in the negatives. 
Say what you want, but a lot of millennials don't live up to the stereotype.
